mission: Ben and Sera work through the resonance theory — translating Ankhural's abstract framework into a practical approach. The lattice can be reinforced through harmonic resonance between disparate Force traditions working in concert.
why_now: H21 resolution — the Codex note becomes a plan. The intellectual heart of Part 4.
conflict: The theory requires three distinct Force traditions to create resonance — Jedi (Sera), modern Jedi with Skywalker lineage perception (Ben), and Sith-trained (Kael). It has never been tested. It might kill them. And it requires Kael's full, willing participation.
turning_point: Sera's new truth demonstrated: instead of insisting on the traditional Jedi approach, she engages with the resonance theory on its own terms. Principled flexibility — adapting her framework without abandoning her principles.
opening_hook: Ben and Sera spread the Codex notes between them and work through the theory — both of them trying to stay ahead of what they're about to do.
closing_hook: The plan works — in theory. It requires three Force traditions. They have two who are willing. Kael is the variable. Without him, there is no resonance. Without resonance, there is only Torin's sacrifice or Veraine's destruction.
emotional_trajectory: Intense intellectual work -> breakthrough -> the dependency on Kael's choice

stakes.personal: Ben and Sera working as true partners for the first time
stakes.interpersonal: Sera's arc advancing — flexibility without abandonment of principle
stakes.external: The resonance theory is the only alternative to Torin's unilateral sacrifice

setting: Veranthos — camp, working through the night with Codex materials
sensory_details: Codex fragments and archive data spread across every surface; the wound's pull from below — constant, patient; Sera's archaic notation alongside Ben's modern analysis; Desh providing logistical reality checks
action_beats: Ben and Sera spread Codex notes across every flat surface in the camp workspace and work through the resonance theory side by side
Sera adapts archaic notation to match Ben's modern Force framework — her handwriting flowing alongside his on the same datapad
Desh provides logistical reality checks from the supply manifest while they calculate resonance requirements
promises_paid: Sera's rigidity breaks into flexibility (PP20 partial)
notes: R12 — the lattice resonance solution articulated. Sera's arc: new_truth_demonstrated — she's adapting, not abandoning. The shift from 'Skywalker' to 'Ben' may begin here, subtle.
